prompt: original existing app persona only; no prompt edits
questions: same 46 preselected fixed/summary/follow situations from prompt-comparison-plan.json
common_history: Exact preserved original-base messages from prompt-20261114-v1, frozen identically for both models and all conditions. Includes previous baseline errors. This measures direct conditional effects, not self-generated rollout quality.
one_factor_rule: Each non-baseline condition differs in exactly one setting. Schema-conditioned system messages, seed42, greedy, thinking=false, stop IDs, max384/context2048, GPU, source checkpoint and adapter remain fixed.
equivalent_template_policy: If official/training input token IDs are exactly equal, reuse this run's same-model baseline response with an explicit alias record; do not count it as a second generate call.
decoder_off_policy: Remove only the logits processor, retain the exact schema-conditioned input. Never repair JSON or silently accept invalid enum/schema. Content from valid JSON spoken_text can be diagnostic even when consumer validation fails. For malformed JSON the GPT reviewer reads raw output directly; no regex extraction or repaired app response.
bf16_policy: Full BF16 on the same CUDA GPU, no CPU/disk inference offload, no model download, no merge. Record OOM/failure if it cannot run; do not substitute a CPU run as the same-factor control.

review.extra_value: unassessable for genuinely unreadable/missing content, separate from failure and not_applicable
review.limitations: Same GPT authored code and judges outputs; known repeated questions; no independent holdout, no full factorial interactions, no app rollout claim. Preserve historical human/GPT reviews separately.
